text: 1TEAM is the engagement brand of French professional football, run by the Ligue de Football Professionnel together with the Ligue 1 McDonald's and Ligue 2 BKT clubs.

source.name: LFP — 1TEAM
source.quote: À travers 1TEAM, la marque d’engagement du football professionnel français, la Ligue de Football Professionnel et les clubs de Ligue 1 McDonald’s et Ligue 2 BKT agissent ensemble
